description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Rocky Brands, Inc. is seeking a Front End Developer to support its marketing and web operations. The role focuses on developing accessible, responsive, and high-performing websites and applications, collaborating with design, development, marketing, and external agency teams, and supporting online marketing initiatives and project delivery.
Front-end web developer building accessible, responsive interfaces and supporting digital marketing, performance, and SEO initiatives

Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement user interfaces for websites and web applications. Write clean, efficient, accessible, and maintainable code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or jQuery
• Ensure responsive and cross-browser compatibility of web applications. Collaborate with design team members and agencies to implement visual design intent
• Conduct thorough testing and debugging of websites, emails, and applications. Optimize application performance for maximum speed, accessibility, and scalability
• Collaborate with internal and external back-end developers, creative agencies, marketing agencies, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality end products through support, design reviews, code reviews, QA, and unit testing
• Research, analyze, and monitor market trends and demographic factor changes to capitalize/react to market opportunities involving advertising programs, merchandising policy, product packaging, and current web trends
• Experiment, establish, and execute online marketing goals through implementing and maintaining strategy, content management, email marketing, advertising, promotions, social media, surveys, focus groups, and innovative web development/utilization
• Develop and maintain W3C and WCAG-compliant HTML/CSS/JavaScript page-level code while directing/coordinating with internal and external providers to increase web performance and usability
• Plan, track, and manage multiple projects involving various workflows, personnel and delivery dates
• Collaborate, support, and provide guidance to content creators, technical personnel, service providers, marketing team members, product development team members, consultants, and external providers on projects, campaigns, email marketing initiatives, general deliverables/queries, social media, general site optimization, and search engine optimization
• Prepare general and specific online marketing/sales/performance reports on request or in preparation for presentations

Requirements:
• A Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a four-year College or university, one to two years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Advanced skill level in Photoshop, Illustrator, HTML Editors, Mac and/or PC Skills (work environment PC), and an understanding of social media and new internet technologies. Familiarity with web usability standards, accessibility, performance best practices, and implementation
• Required Programming Languages: HTML and CSS (not WYSIWYG editors)
• Ability to interpret technical procedures, documentation, analytics, and governmental regulations
• Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals
• Ability to troubleshoot and resolve daily website issues and support front-end site functionality
• Experience in developing and enhancing CMS-based e-Commerce websites using best practices

Preferred:
• Preferred Programming Languages: JQuery or JavaScript, Node JS, HTML Email
